hints.title: Permutation Evaluation
hints.text: There are only 6 possible orderings to concatenate or overlap the three strings.

hints.title: Pairwise Overlap Merge
hints.text: Define a helper to merge two strings by finding their maximum overlapping suffix and prefix.

hints.title: Lexicographical Tiebreaker
hints.text: Compute all 6 merged candidates and choose the one with minimum length, breaking ties lexicographically.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: |a|, |b|, |c|: lengths of strings a, b, c
complexity.notes: Exhaustive evaluation of all 6 string permutations using maximum prefix-suffix overlap.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General shortest common superstring is NP-hard, but 3 strings can be exhaustively checked across all permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(len(a) * len(b) * len(c)) time evaluating the 6 combinations and O(total length) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Carefully handle the case where one string is already a substring of another before prefix-suffix matching.
